description: This Java source file defines the `MongoMetrics` class, which holds metrics related to MongoDB roundtrip timers, including reporting details, resolution, and a list of maximum timer values. It provides methods for creating instances from raw parameters or JSON, and for serializing the object back to JSON. The class is part of a package related to MongoDB persistence utility functions within the Eclipse Ditto project.
